responsibility: Provides the base GCC target configuration shared by all OpenBSD ports. It defines OpenBSD preprocessor builtins and assertions, CPP and library specs for options like -posix and -pthread, optional native include-path adjustments, assembler and symbol-declaration conventions for .type/.size/.weak handling, ELF/PIC-related defaults, and common libc and POSIX-I/O capability settings. This is the central OS configuration header for OpenBSD targets, not just an option table or stdint definition file.
same_name_distinction: This is the operative OpenBSD configuration header, defining builtins, specs, assembler/symbol conventions, and libc defaults; the only same-stem companion, gcc/config/openbsd.opt, is just the declarative option table for switches such as assert=, posix, and pthread.
